SELECT smac.id, smac.user_id, smac.`state`, smac.app_id, smac.app_key, smac.expire_date, smac.system_name, smac.white_ips,smac.bind_type, su.user_no,su.user_tag,su.user_real_cn_name,su.user_real_en_name, upost.position_id,c.group_id,c.group_name,smac.org_id,g.group_name as org_name, CONCAT_WS(',',GROUP_CONCAT(ur.role_id),GROUP_CONCAT(utr.role_id),GROUP_CONCAT(pr.role_id)) as role_ids FROM sys_hmac_user smac INNER JOIN sys_user su ON smac.user_id = su.id LEFT JOIN sys_user_uset uuset ON uuset.user_id = su.id and uuset.org_id = smac.org_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_position upost ON upost.user_id = su.id and upost.group_id = smac.org_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = su.id and smac.org_id = ur.org_id LEFT JOIN sys_uset_role utr ON utr.uset_id = uuset.uset_id LEFT JOIN sys_position_role pr ON pr.position_id = upost.position_id LEFT JOIN sys_group c ON smac.org_id LIKE CONCAT(c.id, '%') AND c.group_level = 1 LEFT JOIN sys_group g ON g.id = smac.org_id
smac.bind_type = 'user'
AND smac.id in
#{item}
GROUP by smac.id, smac.user_id, smac.`state`, smac.app_id, smac.app_key, su.user_no,su.user_tag,su.user_real_cn_name,su.user_real_en_name,smac.org_id, smac.expire_date, smac.system_name, smac.white_ips, upost.position_id, c.group_id,c.group_name,g.group_name

SELECT smac.id, smac.user_id, smac.`state`, smac.app_id, smac.app_key,smac.tenant_id, smac.expire_date, smac.system_name, smac.white_ips,smac.bind_type,smac.tenant_name, su.user_no,su.user_tag,su.user_real_cn_name,su.user_real_en_name, upost.position_id,c.id as group_id,c.group_name,g.id as org_id,g.group_name as org_name, CONCAT_WS(',',GROUP_CONCAT(ur.role_id),GROUP_CONCAT(utr.role_id),GROUP_CONCAT(pr.role_id)) as role_ids FROM sys_hmac_user smac INNER JOIN sys_tenant st ON smac.tenant_id = st.id INNER JOIN sys_tenant_user su ON st.id = su.tenant_id and su.id = smac.user_id INNER JOIN sys_tenant_user_group tug on tug.user_id = su.id and tug.tenant_id = st.id and tug.group_id = smac.org_id LEFT JOIN sys_tenant_group g ON g.id = tug.group_id and g.tenant_id = st.id LEFT JOIN sys_tenant_user_uset uuset ON uuset.user_id = su.id and uuset.org_id = tug.group_id and uuset.tenant_id = st.id LEFT JOIN sys_tenant_user_position upost ON upost.user_id = su.id and upost.group_id = tug.group_id and upost.tenant_id = st.id LEFT JOIN sys_tenant_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = su.id and tug.group_id = ur.org_id and st.id = ur.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sys_tenant_uset_role utr ON utr.uset_id = uuset.uset_id and utr.tenant_id = st.id LEFT JOIN sys_tenant_position_role pr ON pr.position_id = upost.position_id and pr.tenant_id = st.id LEFT JOIN sys_tenant_group c ON tug.group_id LIKE CONCAT(c.id, '%') AND c.group_level = 2
smac.bind_type = 'tenant'
AND smac.id in
#{item}
GROUP by smac.id, smac.user_id, smac.`state`, smac.app_id, smac.app_key, su.user_no,su.user_tag,su.user_real_cn_name,su.user_real_en_name,g.id, smac.expire_date, smac.system_name, smac.white_ips, upost.position_id, c.id,c.group_name,g.group_name

SELECT smac.id, smac.user_id, smac.`state`, smac.app_id, smac.app_key, smac.expire_date, smac.system_name, smac.white_ips, smac.note, ifnull(su.user_real_cn_name,stu.user_real_cn_name) as bind_user, smac.tenant_id,smac.tenant_name, smac.create_time,smac.org_id,smac.bind_type FROM sys_hmac_user smac LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON smac.user_id = su.id and smac.bind_type='user' LEFT JOIN sys_tenant tu on smac.tenant_id = tu.id and smac.bind_type='tenant' LEFT JOIN sys_tenant_user stu ON smac.user_id = stu.id and stu.tenant_id = tu.id WHERE smac.id = #{id}
